youtube.title: Billi Hamesha Pairon Par Hi Kaise Girti Hai? 🐈 #Shorts
youtube.description:
1894 mein ek French scientist ne camera ke saamne ek billi ko gira kar dekha. Wo jaanna chahta tha ki billi hamesha apne pairon par hi kaise girti hai.

Uske kaan ke andar ka hissa ek pal mein bata deta hai ki upar kaunsi taraf hai. Phir wo pehle apna aage ka dhad ghumati hai, phir peeche ka, spring ki tarah. Uski spine bahut lachili hoti hai aur collarbone kandhon se jakdi nahi hoti. Billi ke bachche ye kuch hafton mein seekh lete hain, lekin ye jaadu nahi hai, unhe chot lag sakti hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
